S8 rubric requires each JSON entry to be unambiguously attributable to a trade AND area. The data model and visible JSON structure include trade and description but do not include an explicit 'area' field on actuals or commitments entries. A scheduler reading the JSON would need to parse area from free-text description fields, which requires interpretation rather than direct lookup — failing the 'without additional context' criterion.

runs.spec_amendment: Add to Schedule Update Report requirements: every entry in the actuals and commitments arrays of the JSON output must include an explicit 'area' field (e.g., floor, grid reference, zone) as a discrete structured field — not embedded in the description string. Entries where area is not determinable from the submission must set 'area' to null with an explicit null value rather than omitting the field. A scheduler must be able to filter or sort entries by area without parsing free-text.

P6 planned entries use blue left-border (--p6color) and no 'committed' class; field-committed entries use green left-border ('committed' class, --commitcolor); gap entries use red left-border and red background tint ('gap-flag' class) plus an explicit warning note. The legend in the controls bar labels all three states. Filter buttons allow instant isolation of gaps. The visual distinction is immediate at the border-color level without requiring source label reading. Layout is date-sorted within weekly bands, supporting scan by date; trade is shown as a meta item on each entry supporting scan by trade.

Each actuals entry contains: sub, trade, foreman, date, area (explicit field, null for missing), men_on_site, work_completed, blockers, channel, submission_status. Each commitments entry contains: id, title, sub, trade, foreman, date, area (explicit field), type, source, linked_p6_activity, notes. The 'actuals' vs 'commitments' distinction is structural (separate top-level arrays). A scheduler can identify which P6 activities need updating via linked_p6_activity and the p6_gaps array which lists uncovered P6 activities with wbs_code, scheduled dates, and area. All entries attributable to trade and area without verbal clarification.
